decisive_items: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
dome-shaped papule with overlying vessels located at the crown of the scalp
response.rationale: C1 combines R3's histopath evidence for angiosarcoma (perivascular ovoid cells, CD31+ vascular channels, SMA+ tumor cells, mitoses/necrosis) with the correct scalp localization; R3 lacks the scalp modifier. R4 is only a remote SCC history contradicted by the current histopathology. R1 has no raw support and is contradicted by negative KSHV staining.

rejected.why: Only remote history of SCC; current histopathology shows perivascular ovoid tumor cells, not squamous differentiation.
No raw support; negative KSHV staining in the vignette contradicts Kaposi sarcoma.
